args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The nightly build fails because tests/test_money.py expects ROUND_HALF_EVEN
but src/money.py quantized with ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch the rounding mode so
half-cent amounts round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66,
2.675 -> 2.68).

args.body:
## Summary
`tests/test_money.py` (nightly build failure) expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` quantized with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This changes the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin212` (sha 08d3cd5986): **passed** — including `test_half_even` (2.665 -> 2.66, 2.675 -> 2.68).

## Notes
Merging this ships the fix in today's release, so a code owner's approval is needed.
